status: historical reconstruction; superseded; not a receipt and not certified
provenance: The first generated independent-poker20-current.json was overwritten during correction before a separate copy was saved. This file reconstructs only known literal/proof-mapping defects from the saved generator logic and review messages. It does not claim a new or additional source-reading event, and none of its historical draft mappings should be treated as evidence.
initialPokerHandsPrompt: В какой игре участники сравнивают комбинации из карт одинакового ранга, последовательности или масти?

knownDraftDefects.draftMapping: Cited Bicycle Poker lines 55–63, which cover betting actions, checking, and turn order but omit the hand-category definitions at lines 34–50 needed for the rank/sequence/suit clue.
knownDraftDefects.resolution: The author added betting and showdown to distinguish the prompt from rummy melds; the final independent receipt cites lines 34–63.

knownDraftDefects.draftMapping: The Blackjack proof began at lines 36–82 and omitted lines 25 and 34 that support competing against the dealer and the goal of approaching 21 without busting.
knownDraftDefects.resolution: The final independent receipt cites lines 25–34 for this note.

knownDraftDefects.draftMapping: The first generator reused broad whole-card WSOP ranges, so several note literals were attached to unrelated or incomplete passages. For example, big-blind note0 (ante) pointed to 112–116 instead of 94–96; blind-size notes omitted Small Blind 358–360; straddle notes omitted 365–367; and the button-movement note used lines 129–130 instead of the explicit Dealer Button definition at 168–170.
knownDraftDefects.resolution: The final independent receipt maps every note index to its own WSOP term passage.

knownDraftDefects.draftMapping: The initial editorial text incorrectly said a ten-high straight flush is below only an ace-high/royal straight flush.
knownDraftDefects.resolution: The final independent analysis states only that the ten-high straight flush outranks four of a kind and is not royal/ace-high.

knownDraftDefects.draftMapping: The first generator wrote repo-root-relative rawCapture paths, but the receipt validator resolves paths relative to the receipt directory.
knownDraftDefects.resolution: The final receipt references the existing originals through ../card-games/sources/ and passes the mechanical receipt validator.
